description: Use when a trading agent needs many token prices at once plus what a buy would really cost. Input: tokens (≤25, base:0x… or sol:<mint>, ≤10 Solana), amount_usd (default 1000). Output: per token priceUsd, confidence, pool, depth and a buy estimate: tokensOut, effectivePriceUsd, priceImpactPct (Uniswap v3 QuoterV2 / Aerodrome on Base, CLMM estimate on Orca). Cached 20 s. Example: ?tokens=base:0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006&amount_usd=5000 Price: $0.008 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

amount_usd.description: Size of the buy to estimate, in USD (default 1000)

tokens.description: Comma-separated chain:address list, max 25 (≤10 Solana). Bad input → 400 before payment (not charged)

name: onchain_prices_batch
title: Batch token prices + trade price impact (Base and Solana DEX pools)
